TV1.title: Anchor A (Li 2023) Fig. 4(c) Non-dimensional Parameters
TV1.description: Non-dimensional parameters (c1, cR, d1, dR) for dipolar gradient bilayer dispersion.
TV1.resolution: Inherited parameters c1=0.15, cR=1.5, d1=0.25, dR=1.5 verified from Section 4.2 text and Fig. 3(b) in archival PDF (Waves in Random and Complex Media 36(4):5715-5735, 2023).

TV2.title: Anchor B (Li 2024) Unit Cell Thickness and Flexoelectricity State
TV2.description: Verification of cell thickness b = a_A + a_B and flexoelectricity state (f=0) in Fig. 2(b).
TV2.resolution: Li et al. (2024) Eq. (51) explicitly proves b = a_A + a_B = 0.02 m. Caption of Fig. 2(b) explicitly establishes f=0, F=0 (flexoelectricity turned OFF, pure gradient elasticity).

TV3.title: Papargyri-Beskou (PB2009) Continuum Dispersion Equivalence
TV3.description: Mapping from isotropic Case H Mindlin Form II constants to PB2009 shear wave parameters.
TV3.resolution: Exact algebraic identification: g^2 = l^2 / 10, h^2 = ell^2 matches PB2009 Eq. (21) identically.

TV4.title: Wave Vector Sampling Density and 2D Zone-Grid Resolution
TV4.description: Prescription of IBZ path discretization and full 2D Brillouin zone grid density.
TV4.resolution: N_seg = 40 segments per leg (121 path nodes) and 41x81 uniform half-BZ grid (3321 nodes).

TV5.title: High-Wavenumber Asymptotics Scaling
TV5.description: Infinite-k limiting velocity for micro-inertial vs non-inertial gradient media.
TV5.resolution: Derived in Appendix A: vbar_inf = l_eff / (sqrt(10) * ellbar) for ellbar > 0; unbounded linear growth for ellbar = 0.

TV6.title: Constitutive Parameters and Material Contrast (Case H and Case C)
TV6.description: Locking baseline parameters for Case H (homogeneous) and Case C (composite phononic crystal).
TV6.resolution: Case H: L=1, lam=mu=rho=1, ell2=0.04, l_iso=0.20 with volume-equivalent AR scaling. Case C: Epoxy matrix + YBCO ceramic circular inclusion (chi_mu = 25.0, chi_rho = 5.546, r0 = 0.3 L) sourced from Zhan & Wei (2010).

TV7.title: Physical Bands Count and Spurious-Mode Filtering
TV7.description: Criterion for reporting lowest physical bands and filtering non-physical discretization artifacts.
TV7.resolution: Lowest N=4 physical branches reported. Filter checks Hermiticity (< 1e-12), real positive eigenvalues, and tracks branches via Modal Assurance Criterion (MAC).

TV8.title: Li 2023 Fig. 3 Microstructure Parameters
TV8.description: Parameter set for 1D phononic crystal under classical, gradient, and thermoelastic conditions.
TV8.resolution: Extracted from Fig. 3 caption: c1=0.15, cR=1.5, d1=0.25, dR=1.5, tau_R=1, alpha_R=1.

TV9.title: Anchor C (Mishra et al. 2026) Homogeneous Lattice Limit
TV9.description: Validation against functionally graded lattice dispersion in the homogeneous un-graded limit.
TV9.resolution: Retrieved Acta Mechanica 237:3951-3982 (2026) PDF (File 3); homogeneous limit (AR=1, zero gradation) cross-checked against Floquet-Bloch dynamic stiffness formulation.

TV10.title: Group Velocity Calculation Protocol
TV10.description: Scheme for computing group velocity vector v_g and steering deviation angle delta.
TV10.resolution: Computed by central difference grad_k omega on k-grid; energy flux consistency <S>/<W+T> = grad_k omega proven in M12/M17.

TV11.title: Symmetry-Reduced Irreducible Brillouin Zone Scope
TV11.description: IBZ boundary specification for anisotropic length tensors under C4v, C2v, and Ci symmetry.
TV11.resolution: Audit M10-a proved path Gamma-X-M-Gamma is IBZ only for AR=1. Full 2D zone grid scan implemented for all complete band-gap evaluations.

TV12.title: Li 2023 Fig. 4 Axis Ranges and Citation Clarification
TV12.description: Clarification of axis ranges and caption citation error in Li et al. (2023) Fig. 4.
TV12.resolution: Archival re-audit resolved author typo in caption citing [59]; body text correctly identifies benchmark Ref. [65] (Zheng & Wei 2009) and [34] (LWZ 2016). Frequency axis bar_omega in [0, 5].

TV13.title: Spectral Gap Resolution Floor
TV13.description: Numerical floor below which band gaps cannot be distinguished from FEM discretization error.
TV13.resolution: Locked resolution floor eps_Delta = 4.63e-11 established from 32^2 vs 16^2 mesh convergence study.

TV14.title: Case C Reference Frequency and Nondimensionalization
TV14.description: Reference frequency scaling omega_0 and non-dimensionalization framework for two-phase composite cells.
TV14.resolution: Normalized by matrix shear velocity c_t = sqrt(mu_m/rho_m) and unit cell pitch L: omega_0 = pi*c_t/L, bar_omega = omega*L/(pi*c_t), bar_k = k*L/pi, matching Zhan & Wei (2010).

TV15.title: Non-dimensional Phase Velocity Definition
TV15.description: Standardized non-dimensional phase velocity for plane strain waves.
TV15.resolution: Defined as bar_v_p = bar_omega / (pi * bar_k); classical acoustic limits bar_v_p,T = 1.0, bar_v_p,L = sqrt(3).

TV16.title: Orientation Angle Derivative and Sensitivity Metric
TV16.description: Finite-difference scheme for orientation derivative and sensitivity metric S_theta.
TV16.resolution: Theta in radians for derivatives, degrees for display. Second-order finite differences on 15-degree grid. S_theta = max |dDelta/dtheta| / max Delta reported in rad^-1.

TV17.title: BFS Element Degree of Freedom Ordering
TV17.description: Canonical ordering of 32 Hermite DOFs per Bogner-Fox-Schmit rectangular element.
TV17.resolution: 4 nodes counter-clockwise, 8 DOFs per node: idx(node, comp, typ) = 8*node + 4*comp + typ.

TV18.title: Circular Inclusion Discretization on BFS Rectangular Mesh
TV18.description: Standard formulation for representing circular inclusion on C1 rectangular BFS elements.
TV18.resolution: Standard immersed Gauss-quadrature indicator function chi(x,y) on regular Nx x Ny BFS mesh. Preserves exact C1 Hermite conformality across element boundaries; documented per Zienkiewicz & Taylor.
